WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT
        dsc.dept_store_chain_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date) AS month,
        p.product_type_code,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS revenue
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    CROSS JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc
    WHERE co.order_date >= '2018-01-01' AND co.order_date < '2019-01-01'
    GROUP BY dsc.dept_store_chain_id, month, p.product_type_code
),
revenue_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        dept_store_chain_id,
        month,
        product_type_code,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_store_chain_id, product_type_code ORDER BY month) AS prior_revenue
    FROM revenue
),
percent AS (
    SELECT
        dept_store_chain_id,
        month,
        product_type_code,
        revenue,
        prior_revenue,
        CASE WHEN prior_revenue IS NULL OR prior_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
             ELSE (revenue - prior_revenue) * 100.0 / prior_revenue
        END AS percent_increase
    FROM revenue_with_lag
),
 supplier_contrib AS (
    SELECT
        dsc.dept_store_chain_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date) AS month,
        p.product_type_code,
        ps.supplier_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS contribution
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
    -- supplier must be active for the order date
    WHERE co.order_date >= '2018-01-01' AND co.order_date < '2019-01-01'
      AND co.order_date >= ps.date_supplied_from
      AND (ps.date_supplied_to IS NULL OR co.order_date <= ps.date_supplied_to)
    CROSS JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc
    GROUP BY dsc.dept_store_chain_id, month, p.product_type_code, ps.supplier_id
),
ranked_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        dept_store_chain_id,
        month,
        product_type_code,
        supplier_id,
        contribution,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_store_chain_id, month, product_type_code ORDER BY contribution DESC) AS rn
    FROM supplier_contrib
)
SELECT
    p.month,
    dsc.dept_store_chain_name,
    p.product_type_code,
    p.percent_increase,
    s.supplier_name,
    rs.contribution
FROM percent p
JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc ON p.dept_store_chain_id = dsc.dept_store_chain_id
JOIN ranked_suppliers rs ON rs.dept_store_chain_id = p.dept_store_chain_id
    AND rs.month = p.month
    AND rs.product_type_code = p.product_type_code
    AND rs.rn <= 3
JOIN Suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = rs.supplier_id
ORDER BY p.month, dsc.dept_store_chain_name, p.product_type_code, rs.rn;

WITH order_products AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date) AS order_month,
        p.product_type_code,
        p.product_id
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = '2018'
),
monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        order_month,
        product_type_code,
        SUM(product_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_products op
    JOIN Products p ON op.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY order_month, product_type_code
),
revenue_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        order_month,
        product_type_code,
        total_revenue,
        LAG(total_revenue, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code ORDER BY order_month) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
),
percentage_increase AS (
    SELECT 
        order_month,
        product_type_code,
        total_revenue,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_revenue IS NOT NULL AND prev_revenue > 0 
            THEN ROUND((total_revenue - prev_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_revenue, 2)
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS percentage_increase
    FROM revenue_with_prev
),
supplier_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        op.order_month,
        op.product_type_code,
        op.product_id,
        ps.supplier_id,
        s.supplier_name,
        ps.total_value_purchased,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY op.order_month, op.product_type_code, ps.supplier_id 
            ORDER BY ps.total_value_purchased DESC
        ) AS supplier_rank
    FROM order_products op
    JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON op.product_id = ps.product_id
    JOIN Suppliers s ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
),
top_suppliers_per_period AS (
    SELECT 
        order_month,
        product_type_code,
        GROUP_CONCAT(supplier_name, ', ') AS top_3_suppliers
    FROM supplier_ranking
    WHERE supplier_rank <= 3
    GROUP BY order_month, product_type_code
)
SELECT 
    pi.order_month AS "month",
    dsc.dept_store_chain_name AS "store_chain",
    pi.product_type_code AS "product_type",
    pi.percentage_increase AS "percentage_increase",
    ts.top_3_suppliers AS "top_3_suppliers"
FROM percentage_increase pi
CROSS JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc
LEFT JOIN top_suppliers_per_period ts 
    ON ts.order_month = pi.order_month 
    AND ts.product_type_code = pi.product_type_code
ORDER BY pi.order_month, dsc.dept_store_chain_name, pi.product_type_code;

WITH
order_rev AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date) AS month,
    p.product_type_code,
    SUM(p.product_price) AS revenue
  FROM Customer_Orders co
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY month, p.product_type_code
),
rev_lag AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    product_type_code,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
  FROM order_rev
),
chain_pct AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    product_type_code,
    CASE WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE (revenue - prev_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_revenue END AS pct_increase
  FROM rev_lag
  WHERE month LIKE '2018-%'
),
supplier_rev AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', ps.date_supplied_from) AS month,
    p.product_type_code,
    s.supplier_id,
    s.supplier_name,
    ps.total_value_purchased AS revenue
  FROM Product_Suppliers ps
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
  JOIN Suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = ps.supplier_id
),
sup_lag AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    product_type_code,
    supplier_id,
    supplier_name,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code, supplier_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
  FROM supplier_rev
),
sup_inc AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    product_type_code,
    supplier_id,
    supplier_name,
    (revenue - prev_revenue) AS increase
  FROM sup_lag
  WHERE month LIKE '2018-%'
),
ranked_sup AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    product_type_code,
    supplier_id,
    supplier_name,
    increase,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month, product_type_code ORDER BY increase DESC) AS rn
  FROM sup_inc
  WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
),
top_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    product_type_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN supplier_name END) AS top_supplier_1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN supplier_name END) AS top_supplier_2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN supplier_name END) AS top_supplier_3
  FROM ranked_sup
  GROUP BY month, product_type_code
)
SELECT
  c.month,
  dsc.dept_store_chain_name,
  c.product_type_code,
  c.pct_increase,
  t.top_supplier_1,
  t.top_supplier_2,
  t.top_supplier_3
FROM chain_pct c
CROSS JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc
LEFT JOIN top_suppliers t
  ON t.month = c.month AND t.product_type_code = c.product_type_code
ORDER BY c.month, dsc.dept_store_chain_name, c.product_type_code;

SELECT s.staff_name AS full_name,
       d.department_name,
       (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(p.product_price), 0)
          FROM Customer_Orders co
          JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
          JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
         WHERE strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = strftime('%Y', 'now')
           AND ((CAST(strftime('%m', co.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1 = ((CAST(strftime('%m', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1
       ) AS total_sales
FROM Staff s
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments a ON s.staff_id = a.staff_id
JOIN Departments d ON a.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE a.job_title_code = 'Department Manager'
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_points
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

FROM customer_points
WHERE total_points = (SELECT MAX(total_points) FROM customer_points);

WITH signup AS (
    SELECT ca.customer_id,
           MIN(ca.date_from) AS signup_date,
           ca.address_id
    FROM Customer_Addresses ca
    GROUP BY ca.customer_id
),
first_week AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id,
           s.signup_date,
           s.address_id,
           strftime('%Y-%W', s.signup_date) AS week,
           dsc.dept_store_chain_name
    FROM signup s
    JOIN Addresses a ON s.address_id = a.address_id
    JOIN Department_Stores ds ON ds.store_address = a.address_details
    JOIN Department_Store_Chain dsc ON ds.dept_store_chain_id = dsc.dept_store_chain_id
    WHERE s.signup_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.signup_date <= '2020-03-31'
),
order_totals AS (
    SELECT co.order_id,
           co.customer_id,
           co.order_date,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total,
           strftime('%Y-%W', co.order_date) AS week
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.order_id
),
joined AS (
    SELECT fw.week,
           fw.dept_store_chain_name,
           fw.customer_id,
           ot.total
    FROM first_week fw
    LEFT JOIN order_totals ot ON fw.customer_id = ot.customer_id AND fw.week = ot.week
)
SELECT
    week,
    dept_store_chain_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers,
    AVG(total) AS avg_order_value
FROM joined
GROUP BY week, dept_store_chain_name
ORDER BY week, dept_store_chain_name;

WITH Q1_Customers AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.customer_id,
        CAST(strftime('%W', ca.date_from) AS INTEGER) AS week_num
    FROM Customer_Addresses ca
    WHERE strftime('%Y', ca.date_from) = '2020' 
      AND strftime('%m', ca.date_from) IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
Q1_Orders AS (
    SELECT 
        co.customer_id,
        CAST(strftime('%W', co.order_date) AS INTEGER) AS week_num,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS order_value
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = '2020' 
      AND strftime('%m', co.order_date) IN ('01', '02', '03')
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, week_num
)
SELECT 
    dqsc.dept_store_chain_name,
    qc.week_num,
    COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) AS new_customers,
    AVG(qo.order_value) AS avg_order_value
FROM Q1_Customers qc
LEFT JOIN DSC_Cust_Links dcl ON qc.customer_id = dcl.customer_id
JOIN Department_Store_Chain dqsc ON dcl.dept_store_chain_id = dqsc.dept_store_chain_id
LEFT JOIN Q1_Orders qo ON qc.customer_id = qo.customer_id AND qc.week_num = qo.week_num
GROUP BY dqsc.dept_store_chain_name, qc.week_num
ORDER BY dqsc.dept_store_chain_name, qc.week_num;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           co.order_id,
           co.order_date,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS order_value
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, co.order_id, co.order_date
),
new_customers AS (
    SELECT ov.customer_id,
           MIN(ov.order_date) AS first_order_date
    FROM order_values ov
    WHERE ov.order_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-03-31'
    GROUP BY ov.customer_id
    HAVING MIN(ov.order_date) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-03-31'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT nc.customer_id,
           strftime('%Y-%W', nc.first_order_date) AS year_week
    FROM new_customers nc
)
SELECT sc.dept_store_chain_name,
       w.year_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT w.customer_id) AS new_customer_count,
       AVG(ov.order_value) AS avg_order_value
FROM Department_Store_Chain sc
JOIN Department_Stores ds ON sc.dept_store_chain_id = ds.dept_store_chain_id
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON ds.dept_store_id = sda.department_id
JOIN Staff s ON sda.staff_id = s.staff_id
JOIN Customer_Addresses ca ON s.staff_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN Customers c ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN order_values ov ON co.order_id = ov.order_id AND co.customer_id = ov.customer_id AND co.order_date = ov.order_date
JOIN weekly w ON ov.customer_id = w.customer_id
WHERE co.order_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-03-31'
  AND 1=0
GROUP BY sc.dept_store_chain_name, w.year_week
ORDER BY sc.dept_store_chain_name, w.year_week;

votes.sql:
SELECT c.customer_name,
       c.customer_email,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS returns_count
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Returned'
  AND o.order_date >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 0;

SELECT 
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_email,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count
FROM 
    Customers c
JOIN 
    Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
WHERE 
    co.order_status_code = 'Returned'
    AND co.order_date >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id

SELECT c."customer_name", c."customer_email", COUNT(*) AS "return_count" FROM "Customers" c JOIN "Customer_Orders" o ON c."customer_id" = o."customer_id" WHERE o."order_status_code" = 'Returned' AND o."order_date" >= date((SELECT MAX("order_date") FROM "Customer_Orders"), '-1 year') GROUP BY c."customer_id";

-- Note: The provided schema does not contain columns for vacation days or sick leave.
-- This query shows staff-department assignments during Q1 2018 as the closest available data.
SELECT 
    s.staff_name,
    d.department_name
FROM Staff s
JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON s.staff_id = sda.staff_id
JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE (
    (sda.date_assigned_from BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-03-31')
    OR 
    (sda.date_assigned_to BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-03-31')
    OR
    (sda.date_assigned_from <= '2018-03-31' AND (sda.date_assigned_to IS NULL OR sda.date_assigned_to >= '2018-01-01'))
)
ORDER BY d.department_name, s.staff_name;
SELECT s.staff_name AS employee_name FROM Staff s JOIN Staff_Department_Assignments sda ON s.staff_id = sda.staff_id JOIN Departments d ON sda.department_id = d.department_id WHERE 1=0
